metadata.title: Refunds
metadata.description: When SaaSy Land refunds a purchase, how the right of withdrawal applies, and what a refund or chargeback does to your licence.

title: Refunds
description: When SaaSy Land refunds a purchase, how the right of withdrawal applies, and what a refund or chargeback does to your licence.

beforeUse.title: Full refund before first use
beforeUse.body: Within {days} days of your purchase, you can get a full refund as long as you have not used it: the CLI has not downloaded templates with your licence key to generate a project, and you have not opened a paid lesson. Email {email}; no reason is needed. Signing in, viewing your key and activating it on a machine do not count as use.

afterUse.title: After first use
afterUse.body: Generated code and opened lessons cannot be returned, so once you have generated a project or opened a paid lesson, or after {days} days, we do not refund a purchase because you changed your mind. If something you bought is missing, defective or not as described, write to us: we will fix it, or refund you where the law entitles you to that remedy.

withdrawal.title: Your right of withdrawal
withdrawal.body: Where the law gives you a right of withdrawal, such as the {days}-day period for consumers in the EU, it ends for digital content once supply begins, if you asked for immediate supply and acknowledged that you would lose the right. On Polar's payment page, before you pay, you do both by ticking a box, and supply begins when your licence key is issued, right after payment. We confirm your request and acknowledgement after the purchase by email, which is a durable medium. If we did not obtain or confirm them, your right of withdrawal lasts the full {days} days.

withdrawalFunction.title: Withdrawing online
withdrawalFunction.body: You can exercise your right of withdrawal online with <withdrawal>Withdraw from contract here</withdrawal>, linked at the foot of every page and on the licence page of your account. Give your name, the email address for the acknowledgement and your order number, which are already filled in when you are signed in, and press Confirm withdrawal. We then send you an acknowledgement of receipt of the withdrawal by email, including its content and the date and time of its submission, without undue delay. A withdrawal you submit before the {days}-day period ends is made in time. You can also withdraw by writing to {email}.

usage.title: How we know whether a purchase was used
usage.body: Our licence server records when your key is first activated on a machine and when the CLI first downloads templates with it, and our website records when you first open a paid lesson and which one. These records decide whether a purchase was used. We may share them, with your checkout confirmation, with Polar to answer a refund request or a payment dispute.

request.title: How to request a refund
request.body: Email {email} from the address used for your purchase. Include the order reference if you have it, and say that you would like a refund. We will identify the order and confirm the next steps. You do not need to submit a special form.

processing.title: How refunds are paid
processing.body: Approved refunds are paid through Polar to the original payment method, for the amount paid in the original currency. Processing times vary. A refund ends the Commercial Licence for that purchase: the licence key is revoked and the right to use applications generated with it ends, as the Commercial Licence explains. Rights under the public code’s MIT licence and mandatory consumer remedies remain unaffected.

chargebacks.title: Chargebacks
chargebacks.body: Please write to us before disputing a payment with your bank or card issuer; we answer every request. A chargeback has the same effect as a refund: the licence key is revoked and the licence ends. We answer payment disputes with the order, your checkout confirmation and the delivery records.

freeServices.title: Free services
freeServices.body: Creating an account or joining the newsletter does not itself create a payment, so there is nothing to refund for those activities. Charges for third-party services you buy separately are subject to those providers’ refund terms.
